Deliberayely 2. I heard that if a muslim miss three juma prayer than he is out of islam. Question: 1. What is the ruling of Kufer in Hanafi if a muslim miss obligatory prayer: a. Non-Deliberately b. Deliberayely 2. I heard that if a muslim miss three juma prayer than he is out of islam. Answer ID: 15834 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1521/1522/M=1430) (1) One who does not perform fardh salah is not kafir according to majority of scholars including Hanafis. (2) It is reported in Hadith: One who leaves three Jumu?ah salah taking it lightly Allah stamps his heart with seal. How did you come to know that such a person will be out of folk of Islam? Get its reference. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
